description: Turns agent replies into live cards you can use: charts, test runs, decisions, plans, agent traces, eval reports and small apps, drawn in your bb theme. Agents pick from well over a hundred components on their own and check each card before you see it, so a status report arrives as metrics and progress, and proof of done as criteria with their evidence. Sliders and toggles recompute cards in place, buttons and pickers send your answer back to the agent (design variants, a theme preview, colors, marks on a screenshot, comments on a spec, a ranked list), and live cards re-read files while a job runs. Pin up to five live cards per thread, or let the agent pin a status card: a pinned chip above the composer opens them, bb's home page shows every thread's pins, and a pin can alert you when its condition turns true. Copy any card as an image, or open it in the web playground. Cards also read bb itself: the thread's context use, the threads it started, its pull request, commits, terminals and plan usage. Adds under 4,000 tokens of instructions to each top-level session, and maps and photos call OpenStreetMap, Photon and Wikimedia Commons unless you turn web lookups off.
